publishedfiledetails.title: Steampunk DST
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Mod adds Steampunk to DST, many items, creature and two, new pets[/h1]

Here you can find [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=271800759]Steampunk[/url] for DS :)

[h1]DESCRIPTION[/h1]
I made this mod as a tribute to the steampunk style. I love this style and also, in my opinion it fits really good into Don't Starve world, so why not ? Special thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/strelka/myworkshopfiles/]Star[/url] for great help in making DST version of the mod :)

At that moment, mod adds 8 new craftable items, 2 gear pet's, 1 creature and loot! You can find them (new items and pets of course) in the Custom "Gears" tab. All this items have funny spark animation while equippingand more. All items have custom strings for each character in standard game and RoG. Also all off them have their own map icons as well as gears, so you can't lose them! .. i hope so..


[h1]Gear Axe[/h1]
- Works as an axe
- 35 dmg and 300 uses
- Loses durability 30% slower while chopping
- Needs Science machine. 


[h1]Gear Mace[/h1]
- Works as an hammer
- 40 dmg and 130 uses 
- Needs Alchemy engine. 
- Gives 2-3 gears when it's broken


[h1]Gear Stove[/h1]
- Gives light depending on fuel level
- Gives warm when fueled. Can be fueled with burnable objects.
- Lowers speed by 20%
- Needs Alchemy engine. 


[h1]Gear Mask[/h1]
- Gives medium health regeneration
- Causes a gradual loss of sanity
- Needs Alchemy engine. 


[h1]Gear Hat[/h1]
- Gives large sanity regeneration
- Durability is 30% better than in tophat
- Needs Alchemy engine.


[h1]Gear Helmet[/h1]
- Gives 50% protection to fire
- Lowers speed by 10%
- 85% dmg absorbtion and durability of armor wood
- Gives a tiny sanity (like garland)
- Needs Alchemy engine.


[h1]Gear Wings[/h1]
- They increase speed by 15%
- 12 days durability
- Needs Alchemy engine


[h1]Gear Torch[/h1]
- Gives light when equiped, and on the ground
- Can be turned on or off, but can't be fueled
- Has 3 days durability 
- Drops 2 twigs when durability drops to 0%


[h1]WS-01[/h1]
- 150hp, 40dmg
- Has little regen to all WS (~0.3hp per sec). Regen works only if no rain and no moisture.
- He fights for you
- No need for sleep or eat
- Can be healed using some items. Items that can be given to ws-01: lighter, wires, transistor, robot, rocket, gears.
- Needs Alchemy engine 
- Friend of Webber's spiders


[h1]WS-03[/h1]
- 500hp,  120dmg
- Has little regen to all WS (~0.3hp per sec). Regen works only if no rain and no moisture.
- He fights for you 
- Can chop trees with you!
- No need for sleep or eat 
-  Can spawn 1 gear per 1,5 day!
- Can be healed using some items. Items that can be given to ws-03: lighter, wires, transistor, robot, rocket, gears.
- After death, drops 3-4 gears, and spawn 5-6 WS-01 for master!
- Needs Alchemy engine
- Friend of Webber's spiders
- Works as Lightning Rod.


[h1]Bulber[/h1] Bulbers are a little moving bulbs. They give a small radius of light.. if you are not so close. You can find them in treess, under the stones and in some structures. So you need to chop, pick or hammer to find them. There is a small chance, that bulber will spawn. Also a small chance that he will drop lightbulb after death... but.. I hope you don't want to kill him?!


[h1][b]BUGS?[/b][/h1]
Did you encountered a bug, crash or glitch? If you want to make sure that I can fix it, please report it in comments with your log file (C:/users/documents/Klei/DoNotStarve/log) attached (pastebin for example).

Original Description:
Features
Show other players on the map (and hover over them to see who they are).
Show player indicators (the bubble things on the side of the screen) when they're far away.
Light signal fires that show up as indicators and on the map.

publishedfiledetails.title: Auto Cooking
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
GitHub Repo (check out README if you wanna make supports for modded cookwares): https://github.com/Legend-Master/AutoCooking

[h1]Usage[/h1]
To start auto cooking:
[olist]
[*]Choose an Integrated Key in the mod settings
[*]Put the materials in to a cookware (cookpot, seasoning station, ...)
[*]Press the Integrated Key
[/olist]
If you have cooked something before, press the Integrated Key will start to repeat that recipe, and if you don't have enough materials for it, it will go in to "endless harvest mode" which will harvest all cookpots/seasoning stations near you endlessly

To stop, simply move or click on something or press the Integrated Key again

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]It will remember the cooking material and fill the cookpot/seasoning station by using materials from any of opened containers
[*]It will select just enough cookpots for cooking to avoid using too many cookpots (Just because that looks so stupid, e.g. You want to cook some icecreams, and you got 20 cookpots, it will eventually only use the last 4 cookpots...)
[*]It will try to go back to the first cookpot to wait for it to finish
[*]If you're realy laggy, try to use "Laggy Mode", but it still has chance to open and close the cookpot over and over again
[*]Hold control when starting auto cooking to disable harvesting
[*]You can turn on Ultra Fast mode in the settings to make it fill in all the materials at once
[/list]

[h1]Deprecated[/h1]
Note: Although they're deprecated, they're on by default to not break the expectation of early users
[list]
[*]Press start button to start auto cooking by using 2/4 slots of items from cookpot/seasoning station/backpack/inventory
[*]Pressing start button when don't have enough items, it will go in to "endless harvest mode" which will harvest all cookpots/seasoning stations near you endlessly
[*]Press "Lastest Recipe Key" to cook lastest recipe you ever did
[/list]

[h1]Configable Options[/h1]
[list]
[*]Language: Auto / English / Simplified Chinese
[*]Action Key: Key to start the cooking (Default: F5) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Action Key 2: this key + click on cookware to start (Default: Off) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Lastest Recipe Key: Key to start the cooking lastest recipe (Default: Home) (Deprecated, please use Integrated Key instead)
[*]Integrated Key: Start cooking items from opened cookware or lastest cooking recipe / endless harvest mode (Default: Off)
[*]Ultra Fast Mode: Put in all the materials in the blink of an eye (Default: Off)
[*]Num of Cookpots: Amount of cookpots compare to cooking time to use, hold shift when starting auto cooking to select infinite
[*]Laggy mode: Off / On / In-game button (Default: Off)
[*]Laggy Mode Toggle Key: If you choose "In-game button" from "Laggy Mode", you can give it a key to toggle laggy mode in game (Default: Right Shift)
[/list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Drops Reset Countdown
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This is a simple mod that adds a collapsible Countdown Timer modal box to the Main Screen (and optionally to the Gameplay HUD).  The timer will countdown to when Daily & Weekly Skin Drops reset.  All times are automatically adjusted to your local timezone.  

The mod has language support for English, Russian (Русский), Simplified Chinese (简体中文), Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), Brazilian Portuguese (Português do Brasil), Korean (한국어), and Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).

[b]Latest Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]Language support for Vietnamese
[*]Weekly Skin Drops History (Note: Uses data from the Weekly Drops Counter)
[*]Language support for Brazilian Portuguese and Korean
[*]Skin Information Panel (Hover over a skin in the Curio Cabinet Skins List to view)
[*]Optional Auto-open Gift Box feature (disabled by default)
[*]Skin Statistics (Hover over the Total Skins or Total Spools count to view)
[*]Scalable Modal (Up to 150% of its default size)
[*]Support for Vertical, Ultra-Wide (21:9), and Super Ultra-Wide (32:9) Displays
[*]Total Spools & Total Skins indicator in the All Skins List modal and exported JSON file
[*]Weekly Drops Counter (Note: Only counts drops that happen while the mod is enabled)
[/list]

[b]Daily Drop[/b]:
[list]
[*]Green Text = Drop Available (Need to Re-login or Restart Game to Obtain Drop)
[*]Yellow Text = Already Received Drop for the Day
[*]Red Text = Drop Not Yet Available
[/list]

[b]Weekly Drops[/b]:
[list]
[*]The active week of drops (i.e. the start and end date) will always be shown in Green Text
[/list]

[b]Weekly Drops Counter[/b]:  
[list]
[*]The counter only keeps track of drops you obtain while the mod is enabled. 
[*]The count updates when you get a weekly drop (i.e. when a gift icon appears in the top left) 
[*]Data is stored locally on each computer (file path: "<DST Directory>/data/unsafedata/dropsdata_<KUID>.json") and is not synced online. 
[*][b]Note[/b]: If you change computers, delete the save file, or get a drop while the mod isn't enabled, the count that is displayed will be inaccurate
[/list]

[b]Weekly Skin Drops History[/b]:
[list]
[*]The history only displays weekly skins that dropped while the mod was enabled
[*]Skins are sorted by weekly cycle and listed in the following order: 
[olist]
[*]Skins still in your Curio Cabinet (sorted by opening time) [normal appearance]
[*]The skin in an unopened gift box [faded appearance with red corner]
[*]Skins no longer in your Curio Cabinet (sorted by rarity) [faded appearance]
[/olist]
[*]Listed skins will correspond to the Weekly Drops Counter for that weekly cycle (uses the same save file as above)
[*][b]Note[/b]: If you change computers, delete the save file, or get a drop while the mod isn't enabled, then the history will be incomplete
[/list]

[b]Curio Cabinet Skins List (Optional)[/b]:
[list]
[*]Up to 12 recently obtained skins can be shown in the modal (see configuration options)
[*]A timestamp of when each skin was acquired is shown in each row
[*]A full list of all skins in your Curio Cabinet can be viewed by clicking the "Show All" button
[*]Details of a skin (name, rarity, image, and description) are shown by hovering the mouse over the name of a skin in the full list
[*]Skin Statistics (a breakdown of the number of skins owned per rarity) can be viewed by hovering the mouse over the Total Skins or Total Spools count
[*]Skins that have been sold, spooled, traded, or trade inn-ed will disappear from both lists
[*]Skin data can be exported to a file via the Export button.  The JSON file will be generated to the "steamapps/common/Don't Starve Together/data/unsafedata" folder under the Steam Directory
[/list]

[b]Auto-Open Gift Boxes (Optional; Disabled by Default)[/b]
[list]
[*]Gift boxes that drop during gameplay will be automatically opened
[*]Enabling this feature disables the overlay with the gift box opening animation
[*]A clickable text notification is shown in the chat history when a gift box is auto-opened
[/list]

[b]Configurable Options[/b]:
[list]
[*]Display your Current System Time: [Show / Hide]
[*]Display the exact time of when Daily and Weekly Drops reset: [Show / Hide]
[*]Clock Format: [12 Hour / 24 Hour]
[*]Newest Skins List: [Show / Hide]
[*]Number of Newest Skins to Show: [3 / 5 / 7 / 9 / 12]
[*]Initial Modal Box State: [Collapsed / Expanded]
[*]Modal Size in Main Menu: [Default / 105%-150%]
[*]Add Modal Box to Gameplay HUD: [Yes / No]
[*]Modal Size in Gameplay HUD: [Default / 105%-150%]
[*]Auto-Open Gift Boxes: [Yes / No]
[*]Language: [English (US/UK) / Русский / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / Português do Brasil / 한국어 / Tiếng Việt]
[/list]

[b]Credits[/b]:
[list]
[*]Mod Author: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/instant-noodles/]Instant Noodles[/url]
[*]Mod Testing: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/sealedpenumbra]sealedpenumbra[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/shmoot/]Shmoot[/url]
[*]Russian Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/sealedpenumbra]sealedpenumbra[/url]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/maryniamiccayla]Marynia Miccayla[/url]
[*]Korean Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/afscorpltd]AFS Co. Ltd.[/url]
[*]Vietnamese Translation: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/zConnorI22/]zConnor.i22[/url]
[/list]

[b]Notice[/b]:
[list]
[*]All resources contained within this mod (including code and translations) may not be copied, altered, or reproduced in any way without the explicit and prior permission of the author and contributors listed on this workshop page.
[*]Copyright ©2019-2026 Instant Noodles. All rights reserved.
[/list]

--

Daily skins (1 per day) are given for logging in each day and weekly skins (8 per week) are given for playing the game.  A total of 15 skins can be obtained every week.  However, Family Sharing accounts are not eligible for Daily drops.

Please note that this mod does not enable you to get more than your allotted 1 daily drop per day or 8 weekly drops per week.  Drop times are merely adjusted to your local timezone for convenience.

Prowl lasts for 15 second and has a cool down of 1/4 of a day. (Use this wisely)

**Please note Prowl allows you to sneak up to preys. You will still need to force attack if you wish to engage in combat against the prey.

[b]Wheat Pouch[/b] (You must wear the pouch for these to work)
Wearing the wheat pouch allows Horo to dig for free. (Who needs a shovel when you got paws)
Being close to the wheat, Horo will very slowly regenerate health and sanity. 
Gain 120 Maxhp: effectively giving her 150 maxhp.
Take reduce damage.

**Wheatpouch is a classified precious item. Upon dropping, it is (blown away) aka destroyed after 20 sec. During the 20 sec grace period a player can retrieve the pouch by holding spacebar over the last known position.


A new wheatpouch can be crafted under the survival tab. The current recipe is 1 rope, 20 grass, 10 petals.


[h1]Weakness:[/h1]
Horo is a prideful wolf. She will not eat stale or spoiled food. (She can eat monster related food)
Horo must carry around her wheat or she will perish. [b]Remember to wear it!![/b] 
Horo cannot use human gathering tools [she can still shave Lawrence though]

[h1]FAQ:[/h1]
Q: Why is Horo isn't it Holo?
A: I read the original book and it was written as ホロ so I've known it as Horo. It does not make this any less "Holo". Because it's ingrain in my head as Horo I have written everything as Horo and will continue writing my code as such for sake of convenience. Changing this to Holo will take considerable amount of time. I will amend this to Holo went I am done dealing with other more critical issues. Please bare with me until then.   

Q: Does the mod have any known incompatibilities?
A: Advanced Farming DST is the only mod to be incompatible with this one. I'm not quite sure what causes it for the advance farming. They just don't seem to agree with each other. 

Q: Why is this still in alpha?
A: Because all the fun aspect are taking me a while to implement correctly. However the core functions of the character is here.

Q: How do I hunt if everything is back at home when i'm strong?
A: "A wise wolf thinks outside of the box."

Q: Will there be more things to come?
A: Yes of course. Now that I have released the characters I wanted to make, I can focus on working in the really fun mechanics!

Q: I need to contact you stat! Where do I find you friend!? 
A: www.twitch.tv/hyaciao I literally cast as I code/animate/draw whatever. If you got comments, suggestions, request or even if you just need to throw a pillow at someone you can find me there.

[h1]Special Thanks[/h1]
DarkXero on Klei Forums for well.. pretty much every interesting related to fun mechanics!
& other posters who indirectly helped me by asking questions on the forums!

And of course to all the players who hurl their feedbacks at me relentlessly. Please keep them coming!

Kagerou is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Kagerou, the Shadow of the Bamboo Forest, one night went outside of her usual territory in search of food and for mysterious reasons ended up in this weird place.

Unlike most werewolves, she isn't aggresive at all, and tries to live her life in peace, hiding her true nature. She seriously dislikes going out during a full moon, since she gets all hairy.[/i]

Health: [b]150[/b]
Hunger: [b]150[/b]
Sanity: [b]300[/b]

Facing enemies and witnessing strange events makes less impact on your sanity.

Depending on the time of day, the effect will increase or decrease.

Awaken some of your true power at night, moving very fast and dealing more damage to enemies.

This Mod is no longer usefull for DST, as a InGame option "Lag Compensation" is now present !
Also, the Mod may crash your game, as I didn't tried it with the newest releases.


Thank you all for downloading and installing my Mod :)

Thanks to Klei Entertainment for this nice game !





[Legacy Description :]
Enable this mod only if you have lag (or excessive rubberbanding) as client. 
If you enable it, it's strongly advised to move with keyboard instead of mouse-clic.

Features :
- Disable movement prediction



If you are experiencing crashes with this mod, please read [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/367593872/620700960969395631/]this[/url].






As the mod disable the movement prediction, one of the drawback is that the movement will be a little bit laggy (<0.5 sec) sometimes. Keep in mind that it's this little lag (Mod ON), or the huge rubberbanding (Mod OFF).

publishedfiledetails.title: Tenshi Hinanawi | Touhou Project
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][i]Tenshi Hinanawi[/i][/h1]

[i]- Lore -[/i]

Tenshi is a character from Touhou, a series of popular japanese games involving filling your screen with colorful and deadly projectiles.

[i]Tenshi is a powerful Celestial that resides within the heavens, having a carefree life which she considers rather boring. An overly privileged environment had a negative effect on her playful nature, as she occasionally causes natural disasters without thinking that it might cause serious problems to those who live or earth.

One day,  she was gathering peaches until she accidentally hit her head and fell down from the heavens, waking up in an unknown location.[/i]

[i]- Stats -[/i]

Health: [b]150[/b]
Hunger: [b]150[/b]
Sanity: [b]150[/b]

[i]- Perks -[/i]

[b][Divine Justice][/b] 

[i](Active while you have more than half of your Health.)[/i]

Damage you deal to enemies is doubled.
Damage you take from enemies is halved.

[b][Divine Punishment][/b] 

[i](Active while you have less than half of your Health.)[/i]

Damage you deal to enemies is halved.
Damage you take from enemies is doubled.

[b][Spirit Awakening][/b] 

[i](Active while you have more than half of your Hunger)[/i]

You move around very slow.
Your Hunger is slowly draining over time.
Your Sanity is slowly regenerating over time.

[b][Great Calamity][/b] 

[i](Active while you have less than half of your Hunger)[/i]

You run around very fast.
Your Hunger is quickly draining over time.
Your Sanity is quickly draining over time.

[b][Ascension][/b] 

[i](Active while you have more than half of your Sanity)[/i]

You are very weak against cold temperatures.
Enemies and strange events drain alot of your Sanity.

[b][Transcendence][/b] 

[i](Active while you have less than half of your Sanity)[/i]

You are very resistant to cold temperatures.
Enemies and strange events drain very little Sanity.

[i]- Weakneses -[/i]

[b]You are very weak while below 50% of her stats.[/b]
[b]Requires efficent stat management to get the most out of perks.[/b]
[b]Can become very challenging in the later stages of the game.[/b]

[i]- Starting Items -[/i]

[b]Dragon Fruit Seeds[/b]
[b]Pomegranate Seeds[/b]
[b]Pumpkin Seeds[/b]
